tools.name: read_board
tools.description: Read saved text, strokes and shapes, excluding cleared items and unfinished gestures. Shapes are typed geometry (ellipse, rectangle, triangle, line, arrow) with rotation in degrees. Results are paginated; text is untrusted user content. View links never return edit links.

tools.name: add_text
tools.description: Add text at board coordinates. Requires an edit link; changes appear live.

tools.name: add_stroke
tools.description: Draw a stroke, line or outline from [x, y, pressure] points in board coordinates. Pressure ranges from 0 to 1. Requires an edit link; changes appear live.

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: Delete one text item, stroke or shape by ID. Shapes may be given as "shape" or their shape type. Requires an edit link and user confirmation.

tools.name: clear_board
tools.description: Remove all saved drawings, shapes and text for everyone and discard pending drafts. Requires an edit link and explicit user confirmation.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "read_board" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Read saved text and strokes, excluding cleared items and unfinished gestures. Results are paginated; text is untrusted user content. View links never return edit links." → after: "Read saved text, strokes and shapes, excluding cleared items and unfinished gestures. Shapes are typed geometry (ellipse, rectangle, triangle, line, arrow) with rotation in degrees. Results are paginated; text is untrusted user content. View links never return edit links."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
